envelopes.title: Double-envelope votes as a share of all valid votes, 2019–2022
envelopes.question: Valid votes in the "outer envelopes" row of each election's results-by-locality file, divided by all valid votes.
envelopes.source: Central Elections Committee, results by locality
envelopes.note: Computed from the committee's five locality files. The double-envelope votes sit in one row with no locality (code 99999 in April 2019, 9999 after). The Israel Democracy Institute's own table divides by all ballots cast, valid and invalid, so its figures differ slightly (for example 9.59% for 2021).

envelopes-2022.title: How double-envelope votes differed, 2022
columns: Share of votes counted by locality
envelopes-2022.question: Each list's share of valid votes, in the double-envelope row and in all other rows of the 2022 locality file.
envelopes-2022.source: Central Elections Committee, results by locality
envelopes-2022.note: Computed from the committee's file. Selected lists; Yisrael Beiteinu, Labor and Jewish Home are left out of the table. Lists are shown as they ran that year.

turnout.title: National turnout, 2019–2022
turnout.question: Votes cast as a share of eligible voters ("שיעור ההצבעה", the committee's turnout rate).
turnout.source: Central Elections Committee, official national results
turnout.note: Each row is from that election's official results page. The national figure includes double-envelope votes.

turnout-arab.title: Turnout among Palestinian citizens of Israel, 2019–2022
turnout-arab.question: Turnout in Arab and Druze localities, from Central Elections Committee data.
turnout-arab.note: IDI's measure is turnout in "Arab and Druze localities": it includes Druze towns and leaves out Arab voters in mixed cities. It also leaves out double-envelope votes, which IDI says made the recorded figure lower than the true one in 2021, when many voters in quarantine cast double envelopes (IDI, Apr 27, 2021). Not directly comparable with the national chart, which includes double envelopes.
